T07.title: 轮足机器人从近跌倒状态恢复直立

T07.action: 6 bounded VMC targets: left angle/length/wheel speed, right angle/length/wheel speed. Scales .35 rad, .06 m plus .237 m (clipped .18-.30), 24 rad/s.
T07.scoring: Native reward and termination terms, plus exact native recovery outcome hook and terrain tracking diagnostics. T07 per-recovery success is tilt<.25 rad and clearance>.14 m held .30 s after .25 s grace, deadline2.5s; episode survival is not success. T08 has no native binary success.
